verdict.rationale: Factory supports event-driven automation through specific integrations — assigning a Jira/Linear issue or mentioning @Factory triggers Droid to investigate/implement, and CI/CD pipelines can invoke droid exec on events like PRs to auto-review code. However, these are fixed, product-defined triggers rather than a general user-configurable rules engine where arbitrary events map to arbitrary actions. Missing for 10: a documented rules/trigger configuration system, support for custom event types beyond the built-in Jira/Linear/PR integrations, and evidence of conditional logic in automation.
